investigated.name: Sagelio

investigated.decision: Remain station-level fail-closed; require exact QR/direct-payment or connector mapping.

investigated.name: Uattzy / UAU
freshEvidence: Current first-party Uattzy FAQ states that the exact tariff and any extra fees are displayed for each connector before charging and that prices may vary with power, duration and bay-occupancy time.

A July 2026 specialist publication reports a new proprietary-network grid effective 2026-07-01: app/RFID Quick 0.57 EUR/kWh; app/RFID Fast/Ultra Fast 0.67; POS Quick 0.61; POS Fast/Ultra Fast 0.72; no activation or per-minute charging fee.

A Uattzy corporate social post corroborates that from 2026-07-01 the proprietary network uses unified tariffs by charging type and removes activation/per-minute charging costs, but the numeric PDF values were not recovered from a first-party crawlable source.
investigated.decision: Do not promote the third-party numeric grid yet because the current first-party FAQ still requires connector-level display and allows variable components. Preserve the July grid as a high-value candidate for direct verification in the app/PDF/backend.
investigated.resumeCondition: Recover the Uattzy first-party tariff PDF/app payload or deterministic connector API confirming the four July numeric values and applicability to UTZ/ESH/GAS inventory.
